rule.name: BigDecimalExactDivide
rule.message: BigDecimal.divide(divisor) with one argument returns the exact quotient and throws an ArithmeticException (Non-terminating decimal expansion) when there is none, as for 1 divided by 3. It passes every test with round amounts and fails in production on the first value that does not divide evenly. Pass a scale and a rounding mode: total.divide(parts, 2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN), or a MathContext. An exception fits a divisor that is always a power of ten, or a constant from another file that is known to terminate.
